rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for machines that operate by themselves and, in rule-based contexts, consequences that happen automatically.

example.english: This washing machine has an automatic shut-off function.
example.traditional: 呢部洗衣機有自動停機功能。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sai2 ji1 gei1 jau5 zi6 dung6 ting4 gei1 gung1 nang4

rows.note: Use this for a reaction or action carried out without conscious thought, especially from instinct or habit.

example.english: I gave the clock an automatic glance without thinking.
example.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 ji3 sik1 gam2 mong6 zo2 go3 zung1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a semi-automatic firearm that reloads itself but fires one shot per trigger pull.

example.english: This is a pistol with automatic reloading that fires one shot per trigger pull.
example.traditional: 呢支係半自動手槍，每扣一次扳機就射一發。
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 hai6 bun3 zi6 dung6 sau2 coeng1 mui5 kau3 jat1 ci3 baan1 gei1 zau6 se6 jat1 faat3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a firearm that continues firing while the trigger is held down.

example.english: This gun has an automatic mode and keeps firing while you hold the trigger down.
example.traditional: 呢支槍一扣住扳機，就會全自動連續射擊。
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 coeng1 jat1 kau3 zyu6 baan1 gei1 zau6 wui5 cyun4 zi6 dung6 lin4 zuk6 se6 gik1
